text: `va_get [T] pack index` shall return a complete exact-T value or fault with `invalid_variadic_access` for an absent/wrong-type index. T shall be an ordinary supported value type. All indices shall use their complete unsigned value without masking/narrowing; retrieval shall not advance a cursor.
